topic.title: License Server Report in XML Format

body.p: The license server also provides the information from the Allocated License Report page as XML, at: http://hostName:port/oXygenLicenseServlet/license-servlet/report-xml. You can also open it from the Statistics in XML format link at the bottom of the Allocated License Report page.
Use this report to monitor the license server from a script or from another application, instead of using the report pages in a web browser.

The report contains the following information:
Server status - The time when the license server was started and the version of the license server.
License counts - The number of used licenses and, if the license key has a fixed number of licenses, the total number of licenses and the number of available licenses.
Request statistics - The number of rejected requests, the number of acknowledged requests, and the average time a license is held.
Intervals - The license refresh interval and the license timeout interval.
License key details - The version, the date, and the signature of the license key.
Current running instances - The list of users who hold a license, if at least one license is in use.
This report is a snapshot of the current state of the license server. To see the individual license requests that were granted or rejected over time, use the licensing events report instead.
body.note: This report is protected in the same way as the other license server management pages. You must use the same credentials to access it.
